title: Can you add a new Moderator rank.

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
I'll be honest, I don't think we have the player count on the server to make this worthwhile. 

If things were super busy and the moderators didn't have time to moderate chat as well as the rest of the server, the idea of chat moderators could be nice. However, I don't think it's too much to expect our mods to take on both task here on Avicus.

As I was saying in the last thread you made, feel free to contact a Senior staff member with any issues you have regarding moderators not doing their jobs. We can, if needed, take appropriate steps to make sure fix up their game.
